name: Annas's daughter (Caiphas's wife)
title: Link between Annas and Caiphas
summary: Annas's daughter was married to Caiphas, who was the high priest in the year Jesus was condemned. The marriage made Caiphas Annas's son-in-law, which explains why Annas still had great influence. Her name is not given.

keyEvents.title: Caiphas's wife
keyEvents.description: Caiphas was Annas's son-in-law, since he was married to Annas's daughter, and Jesus was first brought to Annas.
